headline: Scripts can no longer sneak past the checks that read them
lede: The CI scope table is now self-pinning: edits to any file a harness check reads as raw text face that check inside their own PR, closing the ~24-hour staleness hole that red-shitted main twice last week.

notes.text: #1387 shipped (PR #1439): scripts/telemetry.sh, FORGE.md, checks.mjs and ~115 more pinned files now classify as real code — a PR touching them runs the checks that consume them, not just the selftest.

The pin list is derived from the check sources themselves, so it cannot go stale; ciscope --selftest — run by every PR including docs-only — fails loudly if the derivation ever dies, with anchor trips on telemetry.sh and main-ok.sh.

Proven both directions: forcing an empty derivation reddens exactly the new guards, and replaying last week's #1299 break (deleting a telemetry pulse field) now fails fast in the offending PR instead of freezing main for a day.
